extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. Teach: (1) A number tells HOW MANY things there are. (2) A numeral is the symbol we write (7, 15). (3) Count by touching each thing once and saying one number name. (4) Numbers 1-20 in order. (5) 11 is more than 9 even though 9 looks bigger. Misconceptions: "number and numeral are the same" (number is the idea, numeral is the symbol), "count in any order" (touch each thing once, say one number name in order), "9 is bigger than 11" (11 has two digits, it is more than 9). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function CountingGame), NOT export default. Export interface CountingGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
